_: The toys /get.html publishes. One object per toy. Everything measurable is measured at build time and must NOT be typed here: size, sha256. `src` is a path relative to the projects directory (mot-dang's parent) or absolute — the toy is published from where it is built. `open` is a URL or site-relative path for a toy with no file. `page` is a longer page on this site, if it has one. `price` in baht; a price with no `buy` URL is held out of the build rather than printed with nothing to tap. `draft: true` holds a row. `on` is any of android · ios · web · desktop · print. `k` is extra words the search should match, never displayed.
